name: Solitaire-Rule-Reasoning-Benchmark
description:
Solitaire Rule Reasoning Benchmark
	


	
		
		Overview
	

The dataset aims to benchmark LLMs on how well they can reason about simple rules. We use Solitaire games as testbeds for creating rule questions. Despite the simplicity of rules, these games have numerous variations, each played very differently, making them ideal for our research questions.
Our findings show that most LLMs perform poorly on this task. However, this performance can be improved through fine-tuning. More… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/bbateni/Solitaire-Rule-Reasoning-Benchmark.
reputation: A recent research benchmark with limited but growing adoption among researchers studying rule-based reasoning in LLMs.
